text_block_list.text:
After talking with Смарт Фалкон, we
decide to
take a relaxing trip to a local
beach (though we
wish it was Dubai).
Eishin Flash seems skeptical at
first...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But after Смарт Фалкон and I encourage
her,
Eishin Flash begins to wonder if
choosing the easy
path was the right
thing to do.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To give her one last push and help her
truly face
herself, I arrange a rematch for
her with Мистер Си Би
text_block_list.name: Монолог
